# Handover: CloudFormation stack "legacy-integration" to Terraform

Generated by cfn2tf. 17 resources, 17 import blocks. Nothing is created, replaced or deleted
at any step; if a step shows otherwise, stop there.

## 1. Keep the resources when the stack goes

Update the stack with the same template plus DeletionPolicy and UpdateReplacePolicy Retain on
every resource. Only those two attributes change, so CloudFormation touches no resource.

    aws cloudformation update-stack --stack-name legacy-integration \
      --template-body file://retain-template.json \
      --parameters ParameterKey=Environment,UsePreviousValue=true ParameterKey=ExportRetentionDays,UsePreviousValue=true \
      --capabilities CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM
    aws cloudformation wait stack-update-complete --stack-name legacy-integration

## 2. Plan the import and check it is a pure import

    terraform init
    terraform plan -out handover.plan
    terraform show -json handover.plan > plan.json
    cfn2tf -check-plan plan.json

The check must report "17 to import, 0 real changes". A real change is a difference between
this code and what is deployed: fix the code (or the resource, through the stack) and plan
again. Do not apply a plan that changes anything. Equivalent JSON rewrites (the same policy
with other whitespace) are listed separately and are safe.

## 3. Import

    terraform apply handover.plan
    terraform plan -detailed-exitcode    # exit code 0: no changes

## 4. Retire the stack

    aws cloudformation delete-stack --stack-name legacy-integration
    aws cloudformation wait stack-delete-complete --stack-name legacy-integration
    terraform plan -detailed-exitcode    # still exit code 0: every resource survived

Then delete imports.tf; the resources live in the Terraform state now.

## Rollback

Until step 4 nothing has moved: remove the Terraform state (terraform state rm on each address,
or delete the workspace) and the stack still owns everything. After step 4, the resources are
retained and owned by Terraform; to give them back, create a stack with resource import
(aws cloudformation create-change-set --change-set-type IMPORT).
